# PROCESS — cand_0004 (built on champion cand_0001)

Capability = the spreadsheet agent's system prompt (`prompt.md`). Reader = azure/gpt-5.5 (strong-but-mid). Only `prompt.md` editable.

## Situation entering this iteration
- Champion cand_0001 (val 0.634). cand_0002 (+0.007, REJECTED) and cand_0003 (−0.033, REJECTED) both added *behavioral* rules — "read full extent / locate by header", "on row-deletion fill from below", "write `#N/A` on unmatched lookup", "coerce text→number". Both regressed passing tasks. cand_0003 (read-scope + deletion + `#N/A`, NO coercion) still broke {267-18, 2768, 347-49, 430-43, 45300, 47699, 58484} → those levers are REFUTED as regressive and must not be re-added.
- Verified grader mechanic in `adapter.py`: the final code is replayed on 2 hidden inputs; formulas ARE recalculated via headless LibreOffice (`_recalc_workbook`, adapter.py:683) then compared by VALUE. So cand_0001's "write the literal value" is a robust superset (works with or without recalc) and is CORRECT.

## Diagnosis of THIS iteration's 40 failing/flaky trajectories (3 parallel read-only subagents, cross-checked against ground-truth answer files)
| cluster | tasks | root cause | prose-fixable safely? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Task-specific LOGIC | 10281,14207,18137,32023,32468,39946,48983,50486,50755,53305,53449,55039,55258,6698,269-44,250-20,146-49,413-15 + all flaky (30930,32975,35747,42930,49237,53062,55912,56561,58890,49782,50526,53957) | each a distinct wrong lookup/grouping/condition/sign/tie-break/boundary; flaky ones fail hidden cases 2-3 on semantics (NOT extent — code already scans full extent) | NO — only a per-task worked example, which overfits and fails the held-out gate |
| Misleading-instruction traps | 585-41 (prose "preserve commas" vs answer strips them), 398-14 (prose "hyphen for 0" vs answer keeps 0), 157-4 (prose "F to M" vs answer F:L), 577-40 (dash treated as blank though not in stated set) | literal instruction contradicts graded answer, and the contradictions point in OPPOSITE directions across tasks | NO — any rule encoding one answer contradicts another (this is the exact class prior iters regressed on) |
| Formula/`#N/A` edge | 31420 (instruction quotes `VLOOKUP(D2,Data!A1:B4,2,FALSE)`; Python reimpl wrote `None` not `#N/A` on unmatched) | needs either the quoted formula written, or `#N/A` on miss | NO — writing the quoted formula threatens PASSING 53023 (XLOOKUP, fixed *by* the literal rule); `#N/A` rule is REFUTED-regressive |
| Output-contract completeness | 254-34 (answer C2 wants a subset-sum value; agent applied cell fills and NEVER wrote C2) | instruction mentions "highlight via VBA / conditional formatting" → agent did formatting only, never wrote the graded value | **YES — SAFE, this iteration's edit** |
| ENVIRONMENT fault | 34-5 (code byte-matches the answer across all 3 cases; scores 0 only because grading-sandbox `date.today()` clock falls outside the surviving-date window) | non-deterministic clock on a "current month" task | NO — handed back |

## Change made this iteration (ONE cluster; output-contract lever — highest-yield / lowest-regression)
Edit target: cluster "Output-contract completeness" (254-34). Two touch-points expressing ONE additive rule:
1. `prompt.md` line 8 — sharpened the existing conditional-formatting parenthetical: formatting is done IN ADDITION to, never INSTEAD of, writing the graded value; when the instruction says "highlight/color/conditionally format the cells that …" and answer_position is where the qualifying result belongs, still compute and WRITE that result into answer_position.
2. `prompt.md` line 13 checklist point (1) — made "actually assigns a computed value into each answer cell (not merely recolored/copied cells with the value left unwritten)" an explicit pre-finish precondition, with an explicit "leave blank only when the instruction says to" exemption.

Lever types used: **output-contract tightening (skill lever #8)** + **structural pre-finish checklist precondition**. (Deliberately did NOT use the missing-rule / read-scope / coercion levers — refuted.)

## Verify-the-fix + blast radius
- Trace 254-34: final code only did `dst.fill = copy(src.fill)` across the used range and never assigned `'Before'!C2` → 0/3. With the edit, the checklist precondition + line-8 clarification make writing the graded value into answer_position unavoidable even though the instruction mentions "conditional formatting", redirecting the agent to compute and write the C2 result instead of stopping after fills.
- Blast radius = BOUNDED / additive clarification of an EXISTING contract rule (never a new global decision). Verified against the passing tasks in the same class:
  - CF_7349, CF_12196 (passing conditional-formatting tasks): BOTH already write `.value` into their answer range AND apply formatting → the edit ("write the value in addition to formatting") is exactly what they already do → no behavior change.
  - All other 49 passing tasks already assign values into their answer cells (that is why they pass) → the "assign a value into each answer cell" precondition is a no-op for them.
  - The blank exemption ("leave blank only when the instruction explicitly says to") protects any task whose gold answer keeps a cell empty.
- Did NOT touch: the literal-vs-formula rule, the derive-dynamically rule, the range/save/error-recovery rules, or the macro-VBA rule (all from cand_0001, all correct).

## Refuted levers I did NOT re-try (cite)
- read-full-extent / locate-by-header (cand_0002 + cand_0003) — broke 430-43,47699,58484 (+more).
- fill-from-below on row-deletion (cand_0003) — part of the batch that broke 267-18,2768,347-49,45300.
- `#N/A`-on-unmatched-lookup (cand_0002 + cand_0003) — regressive.
- text→number / write-numeric-as-number coercion (cand_0002) — broke copy/reproduce + selective-skip tasks (430-43,61-4,58484,47699).
- 31420 "write the quoted formula" — NEW analysis this iter: unsafe, threatens passing 53023.

## Process & features used
- 3 parallel read-only general-purpose subagents diagnosed all 40 failing/flaky traces (each compared graded code vs ground-truth answer files). Read adapter.py to confirm the LibreOffice recalc mechanic. Scanned all 51 passing tasks' instructions for quoted-formula overlap (found 50452/51313 INDEX-MATCH, 53023 XLOOKUP) to bound the formula lever.

## Deliberately skipped (with why) — this is a near-plateau
- ~34 task-specific LOGIC failures + 4 misleading-instruction traps: no safe general prose rule exists (3 independent diagnoses agree); a fix would hardcode one task's answer and fail the held-out gate / regress a sibling.
- 34-5 (and likely 32023): ENVIRONMENT — non-deterministic grading clock on a "current month/today" task; not a prompt defect. HUMAN ACTION: pin the grading sandbox clock or exclude time-relative tasks.
- I intentionally shipped ONE narrowly-safe additive edit rather than force speculative breadth: with 2 consecutive regressing rejections and an exhaustive diagnosis showing no other safe lever, a third speculative behavioral rule is negative-EV (a single regression sinks the candidate).
